id: ENG-0004
type: realisation
titre: "Kernel: a save refused after the unit file landed completes at the next retry"
promettant: null
reserve_par: null
pris_le: null
restitue_le: null
beneficiaire: jalon:J-KER
exigences:
  - SPEC-KER-012
scope:
  domaines:
    - KER
  paths:
    - packages/kernel/**
    - packages/adapters-node/**
definition_of_done: >
  1. After a save refused at any step after the unit's file was written (the touched
  objects, the blob, the versions index, the state), a retry of the identical text in the
  same kernel completes the save: the object files, the blob, the index and the state are
  written and a new version is returned, instead of the early return that answers the
  previous version and writes nothing. 2. TST-KER-012b is extended to a refusal injected at
  each write step of the save, each followed by a retry of the same text in the same kernel,
  and the reopened project then reports neither an external change nor an interruption.
  3. The mutant that keeps the early return falls under that test. 4. REPORT.md opens with the
  result against this definition and names the requirement with the tests that prove it.
depends_on:
  - eng: ENG-0003
    type: finish-start

notes: >
  2026-10-16: opened by the coordinator at the integration of ENG-0002, from the verdict
  MAN-ENG-0002-2 (probes P2 and P7): after a refusal at steps 2 to 5 of a save, the kernel
  holds the new text while the state is not on disk, and a same-text retry writes nothing.
  Nothing is lost (a reopen absorbs the text as external), but the interface must be able to
  save again without reopening. Sequenced after ENG-0003, which holds the kernel paths.
